pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Closed, Flohr System
pages.notes: Rewrote the overview (it centred the line on a ...d5 break; 9...Bb7 aims at e4 with the ...Re8/...Bf8 Zaitsev set-up) and all four plans: plan 3 rerouted the f3-knight via d2 (the queen's knight is the one that travels), plan 4 was vague. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Closed, Karpov Variation
pages.notes: Overview said the d7-knight reroutes to c6, where the other knight already stands; rewrote it around ...Bf6, ...Nb6 and ...Na5. Plan 1 had ...Nb8-c6 (ambiguous, wrong idea); plan 3 played ...Bb7 only after ...c5; plan 4 was vague. Rewrote plans 1, 3, 4. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Zaitsev, 12.a4 h6
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed a knight from f1, which stands on d2, and opened with axb5; plan 4 gave ...Nbd7 with no knight on b8. Rewrote both around the 13.Bc2 exd4 14.cxd4 Nb4 15.Bb1 c5 main line. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Closed, Breyer Defense
pages.notes: Plan 1 called d4 a break that opens the centre and played Nf1-g3-f5 with the knight still on b1; plan 4 put the light-squared bishop on c7, where Black's c-pawn stands. Rewrote plans 1 and 4. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Breyer, Matulovic Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 had axb5 pressure a6, a pawn that would be gone; plan 2 played Nbd2 and d3-d4 with the d-pawn still on d2; plan 3 said ...Bb7 defends b5. Rewrote plans 1-3 (first plan 3 rewrite rejected for suggesting ...c5, which loses the a8-rook to axb5 axb5 Rxa8; corrected and accepted). British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Closed, Breyer
pages.notes: Plan 1 played Nf1-g3 with the knight still on b1; rewrote it as Nbd2-f1-g3. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Closed, Breyer Defense
pages.notes: Plan 1 played Ng3-f5 with the knight on d2; plan 2 routed ...Nf8-g6 with a rook on f8; plan 3 used a bare f1-g3 route. Rewrote plans 1-3. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Closed, Breyer Defense, Zaitsev Hybrid
pages.notes: Plan 1 rerouted the f3-knight via d2; plan 2 gave ...Na5, which no knight can reach, and ...Bf8-g7 without ...g6; plan 4 offered a ...d5 break. Rewrote plans 1, 2 and 4. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Breyer, 10.d4 Bb7
pages.notes: Plan 1 played Nf1-g3-f5 with the knight still on b1; rewrote it as Nbd2-f1-g3. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Breyer, 10.d4 Nbd7 11.Bg5
pages.notes: Plan 3 had ...g5 with White's bishop on g5 and claimed Bxf6 damages Black's pawns (either recapture leaves them intact). Rewrote it (first rewrite rejected for calling the f6-knight pinned with only a defended bishop behind it; corrected and accepted). British spelling.
